name: UpdateConnectionRequest
description: Specify which fields to update in `updateMask` and provide corresponding values in `connection`. Fields in `connection` not listed in `updateMask` are ignored.

updateMask.description: Fields to update. Each entry must have a corresponding value in `connection`. Credential fields (`apiKey`, `basicAuth`, `oauth2ClientCredentials`, `oauth2PasswordCredentials`) must match the connection's existing auth scheme.
